rows.text: Is "Beauty" an objective reality or a subjective idea? The devout Viewers lean towards the former. They firmly believe that beauty can always be perceived. With enough faith, even Idrila's face can be depicted. The Viewers carved countless statues out of crystal, attempting to capture one of the many facets of pure beauty. This provoked the hostility of a faction of the Knights of Beauty, sparking a conflict. Many statues were destroyed in that great battle, leaving behind only a fractured beauty. Yet the knights claim this was done to avert a far greater disaster.
